_scope_note: Reference measurement on the held-out split. Nothing is fitted, tuned, thresholded or model-selected on these rows: they exist so the privileged spectral baselines and the search ceiling can be quoted on the same records the learned methods are evaluated on. Screening refuses test rows by construction (screening.fit_threshold) and headroom rejects allow_test_adaptation as a config key, so the guard is enforced in code, not by intention.
